lines.text: The LORD restored Isaac from captivity, forgave His people's iniquity, and withheld all His fury.
They ask God to put away His displeasure and ask whether He will be angry forever.
They ask God to revive them so His people may rejoice, and to grant salvation.
The singer will listen to God, who will speak peace, and whose salvation is near those who fear Him.
Righteousness and peace kiss, faithfulness sprouts from Zion, and righteousness goes before the LORD to prepare His way.
